## Provisioning Profile Submission

### Checklist

Please confirm the following before submitting:

- [ ] The file is a valid `.provisionprofile` file.
- [ ] The filename clearly identifies the bundle that directly contains the profile (per [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md)).
- [ ] The profile is **not already present** in the repository.
- [ ] No unrelated files or changes are included in this PR.
- [ ] The profile opens correctly on macOS.
